name: Species Conservation Program
summary: Annual Ontario grants for habitat preservation and rehabilitation, threat mitigation and related conservation work for species at risk, open to NGOs, Indigenous groups, individuals and others. Land purchase is limited to conservation bodies, Indigenous communities and municipalities.

eligibility.rule: The project benefits species assessed by COSSARO as extirpated, endangered, threatened or special concern
Land purchase: Indigenous community, municipality or conservation group that acquired conservation land in past 5 years
Has fewer than three current Species Conservation Program projects
Project is not required by law or done to meet regulatory requirements
Applicant is not a provincial ministry or a federal department or agency
Funded activities run between April 1, 2027 and December 31, 2031
Land securement covers at least 5 hectares across all parcels

status.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.

deadline.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: The fund is open to individuals and groups across Ontario, including: academic institutions conservation authorities corporations Indigenous communities and organizations individuals municipal and local governments non-government organizations

geography.quote: The fund is open to individuals and groups across Ontario

access.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.

window.quote: Each year, Ontario invests in projects through the Species Conservation Program that contribute to the protection and conservation of plants and animals at risk.

effort.quote: Applications must be submitted electronically through the Transfer Payment Ontario portal by 3 p.m. on December 2, 2026.
All applicants will be notified in writing of the outcome of their application.

eligibility.quote: To be eligible for consideration, conservation projects must benefit species that have been assessed by the Committee on the Status of Species at Risk in Ontario (COSSARO) as: extirpated endangered threatened special concern

conservation organizations (such as non-governmental, not-for-profit and charitable corporations whose work focuses on environmental protection, conservation or restoration) that have acquired a property for conservation purposes in the past 5 years Indigenous communities municipal governments
Organizations must have less than three current Species Conservation Program projects to be eligible for funding.
Projects or studies that are required by law are not eligible, including activities that are being undertaken to fulfill regulatory requirements.
5.2 Non-eligible applicants • Provincial government ministries • Federal government departments and agencies
All project activities eligible for funding must begin no earlier than April 1, 2027, and finish no later than December 31, 2031.
Minimum size of 5 hectares (cumulative, if multiple parcels).

after_award.quote: For multi-year projects not in their final year, an interim report with financial documentation is due April 15 of each year of the project, or on other date(s) negotiated with the ministry.
Projects that receive more than $750,000 in Species Conservation Program funding will be required to submit audited segmented financial information as part of their final reporting.

documents.quote: Application is complete in full, with all required components including an application form, budget and threats and knowledge gaps table.
